entries.source: Experience a professional tandem skydive from approximately 10,000 feet (about 3,000–3,600 meters) with breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea, Taurus Mountains, river delta landscapes and golden beaches of the Turkish Riviera.

entries.source: Experience one of the most unforgettable adventures of your life with a tandem skydive above the breathtaking Mediterranean coastline of Manavgat and Side.
entries.translation: Experience one of the most unforgettable adventures of your life with a tandem skydive above the breathtaking Mediterranean coastline of Manavgat and Side.

entries.source: Your journey begins with a scenic flight to an altitude of approximately 10,000 feet (about 3,000–3,600 meters), offering spectacular views of the Mediterranean Sea, the Taurus Mountains, river delta landscapes and the golden beaches of the Turkish Riviera.
entries.translation: Your journey begins with a scenic flight to an altitude of approximately 10,000 feet (about 3,000–3,600 meters), offering spectacular views of the Mediterranean Sea, the Taurus Mountains, river delta landscapes and the golden beaches of the Turkish Riviera.

entries.source: Then comes the moment you will never forget — an exhilarating freefall at speeds of up to 200 km/h. After the parachute opens, you will enjoy a peaceful canopy flight with incredible panoramic views before a smooth and controlled landing.
entries.translation: Then comes the moment you will never forget — an exhilarating freefall at speeds of up to 200 km/h. After the parachute opens, you will enjoy a peaceful canopy flight with incredible panoramic views before a smooth and controlled landing.

entries.source: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing may change because of weather, aviation conditions, passenger preparation and the operator’s flight schedule.
entries.translation: The sequence remains the same, while exact timing may change because of weather, aviation conditions, passenger preparation and the operator’s flight schedule.

entries.source: Pickup from your accommodation at the confirmed time and transfer to the Manavgat dropzone.
entries.translation: Pickup from your accommodation at the confirmed time and transfer to the Manavgat dropzone.

entries.source: Identity, age, weight and health requirements are checked before participation documents are completed.
entries.translation: Identity, age, weight and health requirements are checked before participation documents are completed.

entries.source: Meet your tandem instructor, receive professional equipment and learn the correct body position for exit, freefall and landing.
entries.translation: Meet your tandem instructor, receive professional equipment and learn the correct body position for exit, freefall and landing.

entries.source: Board the aircraft and climb for approximately 15–20 minutes toward the planned jump altitude.
entries.translation: Board the aircraft and climb for approximately 15–20 minutes toward the planned jump altitude.

entries.source: Jump from approximately 10,000 feet and experience around 40–45 seconds of freefall at speeds of up to 200 km/h.
entries.translation: Jump from approximately 10,000 feet and experience around 40–45 seconds of freefall at speeds of up to 200 km/h.

entries.source: Glide above the Mediterranean landscape for approximately 5–7 minutes before a controlled landing with your instructor.
entries.translation: Glide above the Mediterranean landscape for approximately 5–7 minutes before a controlled landing with your instructor.

entries.source: Meet the ground team, remove the equipment and celebrate the experience after a controlled instructor-led landing.
entries.translation: Meet the ground team, remove the equipment and celebrate the experience after a controlled instructor-led landing.

entries.source: After the operation and optional media arrangements, return to your hotel or apartment.
entries.translation: After the operation and optional media arrangements, return to your hotel or apartment.

entries.source: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule. The instructor’s briefing, aviation conditions and operator instructions remain final.
entries.translation: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule. The instructor’s briefing, aviation conditions and operator instructions remain final.

entries.source: Hotel transfer is included; exact pickup coverage and timing are confirmed for your accommodation.
entries.translation: Hotel transfer is included; exact pickup coverage and timing are confirmed for your accommodation.

entries.source: Exact pick-up time is confirmed after booking and depends on the flight schedule.
entries.translation: Exact pick-up time is confirmed after booking and depends on the flight schedule.

entries.source: What are the age and weight limits?
entries.translation: What are the age and weight limits?

entries.source: The published operator limit is a minimum age of 16 with parental consent and a maximum weight of 100 kg. Final approval remains with the operator after the health and equipment check.
entries.translation: The published operator limit is a minimum age of 16 with parental consent and a maximum weight of 100 kg. Final approval remains with the operator after the health and equipment check.

entries.source: Skydiving operates only in safe aviation conditions. Strong wind, rain, low visibility or operational restrictions may cause a delay, rescheduling or cancellation.
entries.translation: Skydiving operates only in safe aviation conditions. Strong wind, rain, low visibility or operational restrictions may cause a delay, rescheduling or cancellation.

entries.source: How long does the experience take?
entries.translation: How long does the experience take?

entries.source: The complete operation is usually about 2–3 hours, including preparation and transfer. The aircraft ascent is about 15–20 minutes, freefall about 40–45 seconds and canopy flight about 5–7 minutes.
entries.translation: The complete operation is usually about 2–3 hours, including preparation and transfer. The aircraft ascent is about 15–20 minutes, freefall about 40–45 seconds and canopy flight about 5–7 minutes.

entries.source: Can I use my own GoPro or phone?
entries.translation: Can I use my own GoPro or phone?

entries.source: No. Personal cameras are not permitted during the jump. Only licensed professional camera flyers may carry recording equipment.
entries.translation: No. Personal cameras are not permitted during the jump. Only licensed professional camera flyers may carry recording equipment.

entries.source: Wear comfortable sports clothing and closed sports shoes. Sandals and flip-flops are not suitable. Goggles and required jump equipment are provided.
entries.translation: Wear comfortable sports clothing and closed sports shoes. Sandals and flip-flops are not suitable. Goggles and required jump equipment are provided.

entries.source: €500 is the agreed selling price for this page. Availability, transfer coverage and optional photo or video services are confirmed before booking.
entries.translation: €500 is the agreed selling price for this page. Availability, transfer coverage and optional photo or video services are confirmed before booking.

entries.source: Send us a message on WhatsApp — we will confirm availability, transfer details, availability, transfer details, age and health requirements, weather conditions and photo/video options.
entries.translation: Send us a message on WhatsApp — we will confirm availability, transfer details, availability, transfer details, age and health requirements, weather conditions and photo/video options.

entries.source: Participation is subject to the operator’s final safety approval. The instructor’s briefing, weather conditions, aviation requirements and equipment checks always take priority.
entries.translation: Participation is subject to the operator’s final safety approval. The instructor’s briefing, weather conditions, aviation requirements and equipment checks always take priority.

entries.source: Guests must attend the full safety briefing and follow all instructor and ground-team instructions during preparation, aircraft boarding, freefall, canopy flight and landing.
entries.translation: Guests must attend the full safety briefing and follow all instructor and ground-team instructions during preparation, aircraft boarding, freefall, canopy flight and landing.

entries.source: Minimum age is 16 with the required consent for minors. Maximum published weight is 100 kg. Health information, body proportions and safe harness fit are checked before approval.
entries.translation: Minimum age is 16 with the required consent for minors. Maximum published weight is 100 kg. Health information, body proportions and safe harness fit are checked before approval.

entries.source: Wear closed sports shoes and comfortable clothing. Phones, GoPro cameras, loose jewellery, scarves and unsecured personal items are not permitted during the jump.
entries.translation: Wear closed sports shoes and comfortable clothing. Phones, GoPro cameras, loose jewellery, scarves and unsecured personal items are not permitted during the jump.

entries.source: The operator may delay, change, reschedule or cancel the jump when wind, rain, visibility, air traffic or other operational conditions do not allow safe operation.
entries.translation: The operator may delay, change, reschedule or cancel the jump when wind, rain, visibility, air traffic or other operational conditions do not allow safe operation.

entries.source: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule. The operator’s dropzone rules, instructor briefing, equipment requirements and aviation decisions always take priority.
entries.translation: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule. The operator’s dropzone rules, instructor briefing, equipment requirements and aviation decisions always take priority.
